name: spot-btc/perp-crowding
title: Perp crowding — contrarian retail L/S account ratio timer on spot BTC
description: Binance's BTCUSDT-perp global long/short ACCOUNT ratio is a head count of the retail crowd. Hold spot BTC only while its log level (as of 22:55 UTC) ranks below the median of all prior daily values since 2020-09, sized by a 40% inverse-EWMA-vol scalar (hl 20 d, cap 1).
live_notes: SIM BOOK, NOT VENUE. Long/flat spot BTC belongs on the testnet, but the venue pool was fully subscribed (10000/10000 USDT across four strategies) at deployment. It is a SimBroker marked to REAL Binance spot (quotes=binance-public): no order book, no rejection, no partial fill. Weaker evidence than the venue sleeves.

Costs match the research: fee 10 bp/side, slippage 0. Report cost ladder 0/5/10/20/30 bp → 1.39/1.32/1.25/1.10/0.96. A dashboard flatten rebuilds the broker from this file with the default 1 bp slippage.

Timing: rebalances at 00:00:20 UTC on the just-closed daily bar, using the L/S snapshot stamped ≤ 22:55 UTC. A one-day delay costs ~0.2 Sharpe (1.24 → 1.05). If the ratio feed is missing near 22:55 the runner raises (and retries) rather than going flat on a NaN rank.

Ratio feed: data/BTCUSDT_metrics_5m.parquet (research archive), topped up by code/spot-btc/perp-crowding/fetch_metrics.py when >3 days stale, plus REST fapi/futures/data/globalLongShortAccountRatio shifted −5 min (verified max|diff| 3e-4, REST rounding). REST keeps 30 days: if the archive top-up fails for a month the runner raises on the gap.

Overlap: daily P&L correlation 0.71 with the live spot-btc/coinbase-premium sleeve (weights 0.56). OOS 2023+ it ties a plain SMA50 trend filter (1.53 vs 1.52); its edge over trend was earned in 2021–22. 2025 was −0.47.
Turnover ≈ 41×/yr at 0.43 average exposure (~52 state flips/yr, spells ~7.7 days).

Deploy check: live weight series (public daily closes + stitched ratio) matches strategy.target_weight on the research inputs to 1e-10 over 2034 days; equity.csv convention is lag 1 (w[D] earns bar D+1), max|diff| 7e-7.
